name: Astro Docs MCP Server
summary: The Astro project's hosted MCP server for its own documentation: one tool, search_astro_docs, that takes a natural-language query and returns documentation passages with their page URLs. The vendor's guide calls it free, open-source and remote with nothing to install; the server answers an anonymous caller without any key, session or challenge, because the deployment holds the kapa.ai key that builds the index. Streamable HTTP only; SSE-only clients need a local proxy, by the vendor's own note.
license: MIT per package.json; no LICENSE file in the repo

agentAccess.notes: Measured keyless 2026-10-03 12:18Z: initialize 200 (Astro Docs server 1.0.0, no session id issued), tools/list 200 with one tool, a search call answered 200 in 0.9 s with ten passages and docs.astro.build anchors. No RateLimit header; no limit documented. HEAD 405; POST {} 406.

payments.notes: Read 2026-10-03. The vendor's guide says the server is free; no plan, price or account exists for it, and no keyless request drew a 402. The index is built through kapa.ai under the vendor's own key, so the caller pays nothing and sees no bill.

jobs.summary: Documentation search inside an agent's turn: the guide says coding agents "will be able to consult the latest documentation when performing coding tasks". A keyless search on 2026-10-03 returned ten passages with page URLs, none versioned and one from the Astro v3 upgrade guide.
